Apple___Apple_scab.description: Fungal disease causing olive-green to dark brown spots on apple leaves and fruits.
treatment: Remove and destroy infected leaves and fruits
Use neem oil spray as an organic treatment

treatment: Remove nearby cedar hosts if possible
